products.title: LEGO® Botanicals & LEGO Editions Olivia Rodrigo’s Flower Bouquet
products.body_html:
Let your love for your favorite superstar bloom with this super cool LEGO® Botanicals Olivia Rodrigo’s Flower Bouquet building set. It includes 11 different flowers, including a rose and verbenas, and loads of details that are iconic for Olivia. Discover guitar-shaped petals, red cherries, butterflies, stars and more. Once you’ve completed it, impress friends by showing it off in your bedroom.

  • FLOWER DECOR KIT – Music and flowers mix with the LEGO® Botanicals & LEGO Editions Olivia Rodrigo’s Flower Bouquet (11507) building set for kids ages 9 and up
  • COLORFUL LEGO® FLOWERS – Create a bouquet of 11 flowers, including a purple rose, African daisy, hellebore and verbena, in Olivia’s iconic purple color palette
  • OLIVIA RODRIGO EASTER EGGS – Discover details that nod to the singer’s life and career, including guitar-shaped petals, red cherries, yellow stars, butterflies and black hearts
  • FLORAL DISPLAY – Fans can add to their merch collection and impress friends by showing off the bouquet proudly in their bedroom, a fun addition to any bookshelf, desk or nightstand
  • GIFT IDEA FOR KIDS – Treat boys, girls and any Olivia Rodrigo fans with this creative gift for birthdays, holidays or a special occasion
  • AN IMMERSIVE PROJECT – Instructions are available digitally in the LEGO® Builder app, where fans can zoom and rotate their creations in 3D and track their progress
  • BOTANICALS COLLECTION – Build more blooms with other building sets (sold separately) in the LEGO® Botanicals range and explore more Olivia Rodrigo sets in the LEGO Editions collections
  • DIMENSIONS – The set contains 400 pieces and measures over 10 in. (25 cm) tall

images.alt: Olivia Rodrigo - LEGO® Botanicals & LEGO Editions Olivia Rodrigo’s Flower Bouquet
Olivia Rodrigo - LEGO® Botanicals & LEGO Editions Olivia Rodrigo’s Flower Bouquet
Olivia Rodrigo - LEGO® Botanicals & LEGO Editions Olivia Rodrigo’s Flower Bouquet

products.title: LEGO® Editions Olivia Rodrigo’s Concert Moon
products.body_html:
Recreate an amazing moment from the GUTS World Tour with this LEGO® Editions Olivia Rodrigo’s Concert Moon building set. Craft a purple record player, a vinyl disk and a LEGO version of the crescent moon featured in Olivia’s tour shows. Rotate a handle on the side of the model to make the disk and moon spin and discover a picture holder for displaying polaroids or concert tickets.

  • MUSIC THEMED DÉCOR – Teen fans can recreate a viral moment from the GUTS World Tour with this Olivia Rodrigo’s Concert Moon (43029) building set, including a toy record player and vinyl to display
  • CUSTOMIZABLE MERCHANDISE – Turn a handle to make the vinyl and the moon spin; open a secret drawer to hide precious possessions; and display polaroids and concert tickets (not included) in the holder
  • COLLECTIBLE MINIFIGURE – An Olivia Rodrigo minifigure, rocking a glittery black outfit inspired by her iconic style, brings the scene to life from her iconic moon perch
  • DISPLAY IT PROUDLY – Girls and boys can show off the eye-catching music decor model as a cool concert souvenir, perfect for a bedroom bookshelf or desk
  • COOL GIFT IDEA – Be a superstar gift giver by treating girls, boys and any music fans ages 14 and up to this set on birthdays, holidays and special occasions
  • BUILDING ASSISTANT – Budding popstars can access their record player in the LEGO® Builder app, where they can follow digital instructions, zoom and rotate their creation in 3D and track progress
  • LEGO® EDITIONS – Keep the creativity playing with other Olivia Rodrigo sets (sold separately) in the Editions collection, where you’ll find more cool merch and music themed decor
  • DIMENSIONS – The 670-piece model measures over 6.5 in. (17 cm) high, 8.5 in. (22 cm) wide and 6 in (16 cm) deep
